basic_details.short_information: Register for Job Alerts CSIR-TKDL Unit is engaged in the protection and preservation of India's traditional knowledge present in ancient texts, including the Indian Systems of Medicine, by converting the information into structured format and modern languages. It aims to prevent misappropriation of traditional knowledge through the grant of intellectual property rights. The Unit functions under the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), an autonomous body under the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Ministry of Science and Technology.

qualification.education_qualification: Varies by post: B.E./B.Tech/MCA (IT/Data Science), BAMS, BUMS, BSMS, Sowa Rigpa degree, Master's in Chemical/Biological Sciences/Bioinformatics/Cheminformatics, Sanskrit or Yoga. See Eligibility Criteria for details.
qualification.details: Candidates must fulfil the essential and other stipulated criteria as on 12-10-2026. Candidates who are in the final semester or whose results are awaited are not eligible. Mere fulfilment of the minimum qualification does not confer any right to be called for interview, and candidature is purely provisional. Post-wise qualifications are given below. | TKD3901 (Senior Project Associate, IT): Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in Computer Science/Information Technology or equivalent, or MCA, with three years' experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or S&T Organisations and scientific activities and services; OR ME/M.Tech in Engineering or Technology in Computer Science/Information Technology or equivalent with two years' experience in R&D in the same settings. TKD3901 Experience: Core Java and above, advanced Java, J2EE, SQL queries, implementing MVC architecture using Spring and Hibernate frameworks, Postgres database, JavaScript, AJAX, JSON, AngularJS, Bootstrap, jQuery, JDBC and RESTful; exposure to JBoss and Tomcat servers; familiarity with IDEs such as NetBeans/Eclipse; proficiency in SQL coding using procedures/functions, cursors, triggers and packages; understanding of code versioning tools such as Git. Knowledge of data science applications is an added advantage. OR proficiency in engineering, administering and managing multiple relational database flavours (e.g. Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) including database migration. TKC3901 and TKH3901 (Project Associate-I, IT-Data Science): Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in Computer Science/Information Technology/Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning/Data Science/Electronics or equivalent, or MCA. TKC3901 and TKH3901 Desirable skills: Proficiency in one or more of Core Java, J2EE, EJB; strong knowledge of Python, SQL, machine learning, and data analysis and visualization tools; understanding of statistical modelling and predictive analytics; familiarity with cloud platforms and big data technologies; good communication and problem-solving skills. TKJ3901, TKL3901, TKS3901 and TKP3901 (Project Associate-I, IT): Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in Computer Science/Information Technology or equivalent, or MCA. TKJ3901, TKL3901, TKS3901 and TKP3901 Desirable skills: Proficiency in one or more of Core Java, J2EE, EJB, Enterprise Java, Spring, Jasper Reports, Struts, Hibernate, Maven, REST, SOAP and an IDE such as Eclipse/NetBeans/IntelliJ IDEA, with working knowledge of relational databases (e.g. SQL Server, PostgreSQL); OR proficiency in installation, configuration, administration and troubleshooting of RHEL7 or above, nginx and Apache Tomcat, with knowledge of RHEL OS upgradation, performance tuning, licensing, patching, vulnerability remediation, Java-based web servers, server hardening and server backups. | TKD3902 (Senior Project Associate, Ayurveda): BAMS (Ayurveda) or equivalent with three years' experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or S&T Organisations and scientific activities and services; OR MD (Ayurveda) or equivalent with two years' experience in the same. Candidates with proficiency in Sanskrit or Malayalam will be preferred. TKD3903 and TKJ3902 (Project Associate-I, Ayurveda): BAMS (Ayurveda) from a recognized University or equivalent. TKH3902 and TKS3902 (Project Associate-I, Unani): BUMS (Unani) from a recognized University or equivalent. Candidates with proficiency in Arabic and/or Persian will be preferred. TKL3902 (Senior Project Associate, Sowa Rigpa): Bachelor's degree in Sowa Rigpa medicine or equivalent with three years' experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or S&T Organisations and scientific activities and services; OR MD (Sowa Rigpa) or equivalent with two years' experience in the same. TKL3903 and TKP3902 (Project Associate-I, Sowa Rigpa): Bachelor's degree in Sowa Rigpa medicine from a recognized University or equivalent. TKC3902 (Senior Project Associate, Siddha): BSMS (Siddha) or equivalent with three years' experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or S&T Organisations and scientific activities and services; OR MD (Siddha) or equivalent with two years' experience in the same. TKC3903 (Project Associate-I, Siddha): BSMS (Siddha) from a recognized University or equivalent. | TKD3904 and TKH3903 (Senior Project Associate, Patent): Master's degree in Chemical or Biological Sciences/Bioinformatics/Cheminformatics or equivalent with three years' experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or S&T Organisations and scientific activities and services; OR Doctoral degree in Chemical or Biological Science or equivalent with two years' experience in the same. Desirable: experience in patent analytics/informatics or PG Diploma in IPR, and good written and oral skills in English. TKD3905 and TKH3904 (Project Associate-I, Patent): Master's degree in Chemical or Biological Sciences/Bioinformatics/Cheminformatics or equivalent. Desirable: proficiency in patent analytics/informatics or PG Diploma in IPR, and good written and oral skills in English. TKD3906 (Senior Project Associate, Sanskrit): Master's degree in Sanskrit or equivalent with three years' experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or S&T Organisations and scientific activities and services; OR Doctoral degree in Sanskrit or equivalent with two years' experience in the same. Desirable: knowledge of traditional medical texts and familiarity with medical terms including diseases, plant names, etc. TKD3907 (Project Associate-I, Yoga): Master's degree in Yoga from a recognized University or equivalent. | Preference will be given to candidates with proficiency in applicable languages, and working knowledge of computers and commonly used software. Candidates who are currently employed must furnish a no-objection certificate from the current employer at the time of joining.

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can apply for CSIR TKDL Project Associate Recruitment 2026 through online mode only. Follow the steps below:
Visit the official website, www.csir.res.in, and open the online application form for the advertisement TKDL/08/2026.
Fill in all the details related to educational qualification, statutory category, experience, etc. Candidates who wish to apply for more than one post must apply separately for each position.

Upload scanned copies of the original documents: certificates establishing educational qualifications (matriculation onwards), age, statutory category (for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/EWS candidates), experience certificate (if any), list of publications/patents (if any) and detailed bio-data. Candidature will be summarily rejected if these are not uploaded.
Submit the application on or before 12-10-2026, 5:00 PM.
Keep the generated application number for future correspondence.
Report at the posting location on the test date and time with the original documents, self-attested copies, photographs and bio-data.

Incomplete applications or applications received through any other mode will not be accepted. For queries, contact 011-26851136 or [email protected]. For technical problems while submitting the online form, write to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be through a written test followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates. Candidates must present themselves at the posting location mentioned against the post code for the written test on the stated date and time. The results of the written test will be declared on the same day. The interview of shortlisted candidates will take place in hybrid mode (offline and online), either on the day of the written test or on another day, as informed after the written test. If the Committee so desires, candidates will be asked to appear in person and will be informed accordingly. Candidates are requested to wait after their written test for results/instructions unless informed otherwise. Candidates must bring the following at the time of the written test: original certificates/testimonials, two copies of self-attested photographs, a set of self-attested copies of certificates/testimonials in support of age, qualification, marks obtained and experience (if any), and a neatly typed bio-data on A4 paper. Candidates belonging to statutory categories must bring the original category certificate issued by the competent authority, along with self-attested copies. The tenure is co-terminus with the project and, under no circumstances, will exceed six years cumulatively, inclusive of all CSIR postings. Performance will be reviewed periodically, and staff not found up to the mark may be terminated without assigning any reason. The contract confers no right to continuation beyond the tenure, absorption or regularization in CSIR. It may be terminated at any time with one month's notice from either side or one month's stipend in lieu thereof. Project staff will be governed by the CSIR guidelines on engagement of project staff, as amended from time to time. The posting location may change as per requirement, and project staff may be required to travel as per need. The Head, CSIR-TKDL Unit may increase/decrease the number of positions or cancel the recruitment process at any stage, and his decision is final and binding. Canvassing in any form will render the candidate disqualified.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for CSIR TKDL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Traditional Knowledge Digital Library Unit (CSIR TKDL) under the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 50 vacancies available for Senior Project Associate and Project Associate - I positions across various technical and traditional medicine disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSIR TKDL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 12-10-2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Project Associate - I posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology, Master's degree, BAMS, BUMS, BSMS, or equivalent in the relevant discipline depending on the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Senior Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Senior Project Associate positions is 40 years. Minimum age details are not explicitly specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Senior Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Senior Project Associate posts will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 42,000/- plus admissible House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these jobs?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the online mode by visiting the official website of CSIR and filling out the prescribed online application form.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSIR TKDL recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test followed by an Interview conducted in hybrid mode to evaluate the technical and practical knowledge of applicants.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for applying to CSIR TKDL?
faq.answer: No application fee details are mentioned in the official notification, meaning candidates can generally submit their applications without any payment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official website to apply online?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website at www.csir.res.in or use the direct links provided in the important links section of this article.
